heading: Codes
planNotAvailable: Impression / Plan is not available yet, so there are no diagnoses or tests to code.
planLoadFailedStatus: Impression / Plan could not be loaded ({status}).
planLoadFailedConnection: Impression / Plan could not be loaded. Check the connection.
viewOnly: You can view the codes. Only a provider or admin can change them.
intro: Suggested codes with their reasons, to copy into your billing system. You choose; OpenVision does not create bills. Chosen codes print on the exam report.
justifiersHelp: One per coded impression item, all on by default. Each points the visit code at that item's diagnoses.
notCoded: Not coded: {titles}. Add diagnosis codes in Imp / Plan.
familyEyeHelp: Eye exam codes. The usual choice for an eye visit.
familyEmHelp: General office codes, picked by medical decision-making or total time. Never suggested; choose the level yourself.
visit99202: Office visit, new patient, straightforward decision-making
visit99203: Office visit, new patient, low decision-making
visit99204: Office visit, new patient, moderate decision-making
visit99205: Office visit, new patient, high decision-making
visit99212: Office visit, established patient, straightforward decision-making
visit99213: Office visit, established patient, low decision-making
visit99214: Office visit, established patient, moderate decision-making
visit99215: Office visit, established patient, high decision-making
sensorimotorLabel: Sensorimotor exam (multiple measurements of ocular deviation)
mod22Help: The work was substantially more than usual. Document why.
mod24Help: Visit unrelated to a surgery whose follow-up period is still running.
mod25Help: Significant, separately identifiable visit on the same day as a test or procedure.
mod57Help: This visit led to the decision to operate (major surgery today or tomorrow).
modifier59Hint: Leave empty unless a coding edit (NCCI) requires one; 59 marks a distinct, separate service.
checkUncoded_one: {count} impression item has no diagnosis code: {titles}.
checkUncoded_other: {count} impression items have no diagnosis code: {titles}.
checkInvalidDx: Not a valid diagnosis code, left out: {codes}.
checkTooManyDx: More than {max} diagnoses; a claim holds {max}. Left out: {codes}. Remove or merge impression items.
checkNoDx: No coded diagnoses yet: code the impression items in Imp / Plan.
checkTestBadCpt: Test "{label}" has an invalid CPT code ({cpt}).
checkTestBadModifier: Test {cpt}: modifier "{modifier}" must be two letters or digits.
checkTestNoPointer: Test {cpt} ({label}) has no diagnosis pointer: pick a justifier.
checkTooManyPointersTest: {code} points to {n} diagnoses ({letters}); a line holds {max}. Turn off a justifier.
checkTooManyPointersVisit: {code} points to {n} diagnoses ({letters}); a line holds {max}. Turn off some visit justifiers.
checkVisitNoPointer: The visit code has no diagnosis pointer: switch on a visit justifier.
checkConsider25: Tests are billed with the visit. If the visit was significant and separately identifiable from them, consider modifier 25.
checkAlsoVisitJustifier: Also a visit justifier: {titles}. Keep it on the visit only if the visit addressed it beyond the test.
reasonEstablished: Seen by this provider on {date}, within the past {years} years.
reasonLastSeenLongAgo: Last seen by this provider more than {years} years ago.
reasonOtherProvider: Earlier visits were with a different provider (no specialty-group rule yet).
reasonCoreRecorded: Core exam sections recorded, with a dilated fundus exam including the periphery.
reasonOrdersPlaced: Orders placed: a diagnostic or treatment program was started.
reasonAdvisory: Advisory only: choose the code that matches the service you provided.
missingOrdersOrHistory: orders placed or an extensive history
evHistoryLabel: History: 4 or more HPI elements, or 3 chronic problems
evSectionsLabel: Exam covers the visual system (vision, IOP / pupils, external, slit lamp, fundus)
evDiagnosesLabel: Condition evaluated (impression items with diagnosis codes)
evDiagnosesDetail_one: {count} coded item of {total} in the impression.
evDiagnosesDetail_other: {count} coded items of {total} in the impression.
evOrdersLabel: Diagnostic or treatment program started (orders placed)
stateEmPick: Pick the level by medical decision-making or total time. No suggestion is made for office codes.
stateUnconfirmed: {code} is pre-selected from the suggestion and not yet confirmed. Pick a code to confirm it.
levelsHelp: Intermediate: evaluation of a new or existing condition. Comprehensive: a general evaluation of the complete visual system, including starting diagnostic or treatment programs.
testsHelp: From your orders list: only rows with a CPT code. Tick what was done today.
testsEmpty: No coded tests in the orders list yet. Add CPT codes to orders in Imp / Plan to list them here.
sensorimotorSuggested: Suggested: stereopsis plus a deviation measured in more than one position (Neuro). Advisory: include it only if you performed it. No modifier needed; uses the visit justifiers.
sensorimotorNoLonger: No longer supported by the Neuro findings, so it is left out.
testNoItems: No coded impression items to point to yet.
testPickUpTo: Pick up to {max} diagnoses this test is for ({n} of {max}).
summaryHelp: Copy these codes into your billing system. Chosen codes also print on the exam report. OpenVision does not create bills.
finderPlaceholderIcd10: Search code or words, e.g. H40.11 or nuclear cataract
finderPlaceholderIcd11: Search code or words, e.g. 9C61 or glaucoma
finderKeys: Arrows choose, Enter picks, Esc closes.
finderEyeAddedRight: The right eye is added to the code.
finderEyeAddedLeft: The left eye is added to the code.
finderEyeAddedBoth: The both eyes is added to the code.
finderChooseEye: Choose OD, OS or OU to add the eye.
finderCategory: category: pick to see the codes under it
finderNoIcd11: No ICD-11 code matches. Try other words.
finderNoBillable: No billable code matches. Try other words.
